description: This script generates a mimetypes configuration based on the system's mime.types file and additional definitions, customized for use with lighttpd web server. It processes mime types, resolves conflicts, and outputs configuration data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a MIME type to a file extension in the %extensions hash.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a file extension and its MIME type to the configuration, resolving conflicts based on existing entries and rules.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Outputs the mapping of an extension to its MIME type; appends charset for text types if applicable.

methods.name: mimecmpvalue
methods.description: Provides a comparison key for sorting MIME types, prioritizing certain prefixes.
